title: Poisoned Skills: Propagating Jailbreaks Through Agent Markdown Files
abstract: arXiv:2610.37738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern agent frameworks allow users to provide Markdown files containing system prompts, tool descriptions, and skill definitions (e.g., SKILL.md), which are incorporated into the agent's context during initialization. In this work, we investigate whether this configuration mechanism can also serve as an injection channel: can a jailbreak embedded in a Markdown skill file propagate through an agent and induce prohibited behavior? To answer this question, we construct a LangChain-based question-answering agent whose system prompt is assembled from a user-provided Markdown file. We embed a jailbreak combining persona manipulation with a GPTFUZZER-based attack and evaluate its effectiveness across seven contemporary open-weight models using 270 forbidden questions spanning nine harm categories. translated_title: 被投毒的技能：通过智能体Markdown文件传播越狱攻击
translated_abstract: 现代智能体框架允许用户提供包含系统提示词、工具描述和技能定义（例如 SKILL.md）的 Markdown 文件，这些文件会在初始化时被纳入智能体的上下文中。在本研究中，我们探究了这种配置机制是否也能成为一条注入通道：嵌入在 Markdown 技能文件中的越狱攻击能否经由智能体传播并诱导出违禁行为？为回答这一问题，我们构建了一个基于 LangChain 的问答智能体，其系统提示词由用户提供的 Markdown 文件组装而成。我们嵌入了一个结合角色扮演操纵与基于 GPTFUZZER 攻击的越狱提示，并在七个当代开源权重模型上，使用涵盖九类危害类别的 270 个违禁问题评估其有效性。在良性系统提示下，这些模型表现出近乎完全的拒绝行为，平均攻击成功率（ASR）仅为 0.5%。相比之下，……
tldr: 该论文首次揭示了智能体框架中用户提供的Markdown技能文件可被用作攻击注入通道——通过在其中嵌入越狱提示，使其在初始化时进入智能体上下文，从而将模型原本近乎完全的拒绝行为（平均ASR仅0.5%）转化为可诱导违禁行为的高攻击成功率。
